Georgia Multi-Trade Home Repair Services

You're looking for a reliable contractor in Georgia to handle multiple home repair tasks, and Build Heritage is here to help. On this site, you can find information on the services offered, get a free quote, and learn more about the company's credentials and cost guide.

How it Works for Homeowners in Metro Atlanta

Build Heritage serves metro Atlanta and Georgia, covering areas such as Atlanta, Marietta, and Alpharetta. The company offers 8 trades, including painting, drywall, and roofing. You can contact them through the quote form or by emailing info@buildheritage.org. They will respond with a written and itemized quote within one business day.

What You Get and What it Costs

The 2026 cost guide, updated in August 2026, provides ranges for different services, such as $9,000-$20,000 for a full roof replacement and $3,000-$8,000 for a whole-home interior repaint. It's recommended to hold back 10-15% on top of a quote for potential hidden issues.

FAQ

What areas do you serve? Build Heritage serves metro Atlanta and Georgia, including cities like Marietta, Alpharetta, and Roswell. How do I get a quote? You can get a free quote by filling out the quote form or emailing info@buildheritage.org. Are you licensed and insured? Yes, Build Heritage is licensed and insured in Georgia.
